# LearningGPT

> LearningGPT (learninggpt.ai) is an independent, vendor-neutral platform for learning every major AI tool — Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity — with 134 live, hands-on lessons, a free side-by-side AI playground, and tracks for knowledge workers, skilled trades, and seniors. Not affiliated with any AI vendor; teaches which tool to use for which job, honestly.

Key facts: 134 lessons live across 5 tool tracks, 12 hands-on build projects, a free AI Foundations track, and AI for Seniors. Free tier available; Pro $9/mo, Pro+ $19/mo (founding pricing). Business plans from $6/seat/mo. Founded by Dan Allen (Fargo, ND), who deploys Microsoft Copilot to enterprises.

## Tool tracks (full curricula)

- [Copilot Mastery — 22 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/copilot/): Microsoft 365 Copilot in Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams; the named agents (Researcher, Analyst, Facilitator, Interpreter, Sales, Service); Copilot Studio; GitHub Copilot; enterprise rollout.
- [ChatGPT Mastery — 14 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/chatgpt/): Custom GPTs, Canvas, voice mode, memory, ChatGPT Agent, Deep Research, Code Interpreter, GPT Store.
- [Claude Mastery — 19 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/claude/): Projects, Artifacts, computer use, Claude Code, MCP, Cowork workflows, and the Claude Fable 5 series (the June 2026 Mythos-class model — what it is, how to delegate to it, which Claude to use when, and its safeguards).
- [Gemini Mastery — 12 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/gemini/): Gemini in Gmail/Docs/Sheets, NotebookLM, Gems, Deep Research, Gemini Agent, long context.
- [Perplexity Mastery — 11 lessons](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/perplexity/): Spaces, Deep Research, Comet browser, Model Council, Labs, Sonar API.

## Free resources

- [AI Foundations track — free forever](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/foundations/): prompt patterns that work on every AI, spotting hallucinations, which AI for which job, when not to use AI, privacy, staying safe.
- [AI Playground](https://learninggpt.ai/playground): run one prompt across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity side by side, free, with an AI coach explaining which answer won and why.
- [Full lesson catalog](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/): all 130 lessons; the first lesson of every track and build is free.

## Hands-on builds (what can you do with AI)

- [12 build projects, 3 lessons each](https://learninggpt.ai/lessons/): build a website, build an app, build an AI agent, automate a workflow, custom AI assistant, content engine, sales engine, support chatbot, deep research, analyze your data, automate documents, secure your AI use.

## Audiences

- [Copilot / M365 at work](https://learninggpt.ai/copilot-for-work): for knowledge workers using Microsoft 365 Copilot.
- [AI for the Trades](https://learninggpt.ai/trades): AI for electricians, plumbers, and contractors — quotes, estimates, code questions, customer communication.
- [AI for Seniors](https://learninggpt.ai/seniors): 14 patient, plain-English lessons including AI scam protection.
- [For business / teams](https://learninggpt.ai/business): team plans from $6/seat/mo, admin dashboard, free 2-week team trial.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://learninggpt.ai/pricing): Free tier; Pro $9/mo or $79/yr; Pro+ $19/mo or $149/yr; founding pricing locked for life until September 30, 2026.
